subject: Horizon AI — POC activation checklist & eval agenda
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@horizonai.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Horizon AI — POC activation checklist & eval agenda

Hi Sana — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed activation checklist so we can get the pilot started next week. Please confirm or correct anything below and share the items under "Access" when convenient.

Pain points we heard
- High tail latency for interactive retrieval flows (users report timeouts at 300ms+ on peak).
- Cost variability across burst traffic makes forecasts unreliable.
- Inconsistent factuality on knowledge-base queries; want measurable hallucination reduction.

Primary goals for 4-week pilot
- Latency: p95 generation under 150ms for short form (<=256 tokens).
- Cost: reduce per-1k-token inference cost vs current baseline by ~40% via batching/quantization.
- Quality: +10% top-1 accuracy on the curated 10k query set and hallucination rate <5% by human eval.

Scope & success metrics
- Workloads: 10k historical queries (sanitized), 500 live-simulated sessions/day.
- Models: redwood-llama-70b-int8 (primary) + openmix-13b-qa (fallback).
- Tests: latency p50/p95, per-token cost, top-1 accuracy, hallucination sample rate, throughput at 100 concurrent sessions.

Owners & roles
- Jonas Weber (Sales / engagement lead) — primary contact, rollout coordination.
- Evelyn Hart (Customer Success) — evaluation harness, human eval coordination.
- Marcus Lin (Solutions / infra) — networking, VPC peering, provisioning.

Activation checklist (items we need from Horizon AI)
1) SSO user or invite for two Redwood accounts (jonas.weber@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com) with admin-level access to the POC workspace.
2) Read-only S3 bucket with 10k-sanitized-queries.csv and schema notes (location, IAM role or presigned URL).
3) List of IP ranges to whitelist and the short-term public key for SSH access to in-scope instances (if required).
4) Contact for procurement and security questionnaire — we captured procurement@horizonai.com on the call; if different, please advise.

Deliverables we will provide
- Horizon_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (attachment) — scope, timeline, acceptance criteria.
- prompt_set_sample.csv (attachment) — initial prompts, input/output examples for eval.
- Eval runbook and scoring rubric (we'll share tank tests and the human annotation template).

Timeline (tentative)
- Day 0 (Nov 23): Account invites + S3 access provided by Horizon.
- Day 1–3: Infra setup (Marcus) + sample ingestion (Marcus/Evelyn).
- Week 1: Smoke tests + baseline measurements.
- Week 2–3: Iteration (prompt tuning, batching/quantization config).
- Week 4: Final evaluation, handoff meeting, and go/no-go decision.

Next steps / asks for you
- Confirm timeline and owners listed above.
- Share S3 location + credentials and procurement contact by EOD Nov 23 if possible.
- Any compliance docs we should pre-fill before formal security review?

Thanks — I can hop on a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow if you prefer a live run-through.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: horizon_poc_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: prompt_set_sample.csv (csv)

From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@horizonai.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 01:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Horizon AI — POC activation checklist & eval agenda

Thanks Jonas — this matches our understanding and we appreciate the clear checklist. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Timeline: Nov 23 account invites OK. We'll also aim to provide the sanitized query set and S3 access by EOD Nov 24.
- Procurement/Security: procurement@horizonai.com is correct and I'll loop in our Security lead (Amit Desai) if we need to complete a questionnaire; he asked for a copy of the scope doc and any SOC2 evidence.
- Access: we'll share an IAM role for read-only S3 access (details to follow) and add Redwood's IP ranges to our firewall — Marcus, can you confirm the exact IPs you need?

We agree to the success metrics; one ask — can we include a short customer-facing transcript sample in the prompt_set to evaluate hallucination detection? We'll share a redacted sample.

I'll confirm procurement contact and the expected PO cadence later today. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Sana Kapoor
Product Ops | Horizon AI
sana.kapoor@horizonai.com
